scripts.dev: npm run build --workspace @myblog/shared && concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run dev --workspace @myblog/api" "npm run dev --workspace @myblog/web"
scripts.dev:web: npm run build --workspace @myblog/shared && npm run dev --workspace @myblog/web
scripts.dev:api: npm run build --workspace @myblog/shared && npm run dev --workspace @myblog/api
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @myblog/shared && npm run build --workspace @myblog/api && npm run build --workspace @myblog/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build --workspace @myblog/shared && npm run typecheck --workspace @myblog/api && npm run typecheck --workspace @myblog/web
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run test && npm run build
